verdict.rationale: Setting `x-proxy: auto` (API key required) routes requests through Reader's hosted proxy pool, which rotates residential and datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically. That covers the rotation and anti-bot parts of the story. However, the evidence does not show block-triggered automatic retries across successive proxies, and there is no way to define your own proxy chain. Missing for 10: documented retry-on-block failover across proxies, user-configurable proxy chain or ordering, independent or hands-on corroboration that rotation defeats anti-bot blocks.
